metadata.description: BriefBar's plugins, in BriefBar.app on this Mac, which installs each one only when you ask and updates them with itself.

plugins.name: briefbar
plugins.description: /briefbar shows what needs you, from BriefBar, tells how a work item and its pull requests stand, and hands pull requests to sessions you can follow.

plugins.name: briefbar-sessions
plugins.description: Lets BriefBar send a prompt to one of the GitHub Copilot app's sessions, or to a fork of it, and hear how its turn went, or stop its turn, when you ask: Send Prompts to Copilot Sessions, in BriefBar's Settings › Agents.

plugins.name: briefbar-pr-order
plugins.description: Lets the sessions that open pull requests tell BriefBar the order those that go together must merge in, and each one's stage: Pull Request Order, in BriefBar's Settings.

plugins.name: briefbar-updates
plugins.description: Lets Copilot sessions tell BriefBar the work items and pull requests they're working on, and what they changed in Azure DevOps: Updates from Copilot Sessions, in BriefBar's Settings › Agents.
